selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to grow stronger in himself?
questions.answer: He wanted his faith to become stronger and his knowledge of Allah to increase.

questions.question: According to the passage, where does that love begin?
questions.answer: It begins from faith in Allah and knowing Allah.

questions.question: What part of the universe did he examine for signs next?
questions.answer: He examined the heavens.

questions.question: What ongoing change on earth is used as evidence in the traveler’s thinking?
questions.answer: The earth keeps losing and receiving creatures over time.

questions.question: Which well-known heavenly messenger is named as proof that angels are real?
questions.answer: Jibril, peace be upon him, is named.

questions.question: In the answer from heaven, who is mentioned first among the prophets?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is mentioned first.

questions.question: Besides angels, what other group from among them is mentioned as appearing before people?
questions.answer: Pure spirits are mentioned.

questions.question: Which revealed book is connected with Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, in this lesson?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What feature of their messages made them a powerful proof?
questions.answer: Their messages were in harmony with each other.

questions.question: What moved the traveler to continue his journey for stronger faith?
questions.answer: He knew that the highest good in people comes from loving Allah through belief and knowledge, so he wanted to go farther.

questions.question: When the traveler looked up, where did he turn his attention?
questions.answer: He turned his attention to the heavens.

questions.question: What direction did he look when seeking another lesson?
questions.answer: He looked toward the heavens.

questions.question: What makes some living beings more precious than others in the passage?
questions.answer: Their consciousness makes them more precious.

questions.question: What historical kind of report helped support that belief?
questions.answer: Reports of angels being seen and speaking with people helped support it.

questions.question: What invitation did the heavenly voice give him?
questions.answer: It invited him to listen to their lesson if he wanted to meet them.

questions.question: How complete was the agreement of the pure spirits in their witness?
questions.answer: Their witness was total, with no exception.

questions.question: What made their witness a strong guide for the traveler?
questions.answer: Their many messages matched one another and agreed together.

questions.question: What did he desire after learning from the heavenly beings?
questions.answer: He desired to study the unseen world and the intermediate realm.

questions.question: What does the passage say all human perfections come from at their root?
questions.answer: They come from loving Allah, which grows from faith and knowledge of Him.

questions.question: What did he do before he began thinking about the heavens?
questions.answer: He lifted his head and looked upward.

questions.question: Among living things, which group does the passage say is most precious?
questions.answer: Those that are aware and conscious are the most precious.

questions.question: Which is presented as the finest group among living things?
questions.answer: The conscious and aware are presented as the finest group.

questions.question: What subject did the traveler most want to ask heavenly beings about?
questions.answer: He wanted to ask about the Maker of the universe.

questions.question: What did all the pure spirits agree to announce?
questions.answer: They agreed to announce Allah’s necessary existence, His unity, and His sacred attributes.
